Capture single-line strings with text_input() and multi-line prompts or descriptions with textarea_input(). [ {"type": "text_input", "label": "Agent Name", "value": "Docs Assistant", "placeholder": "Enter agent name...", "name": "agent_name"}, {"type": "textarea_input", "label": "System Instructions", "value": "Answer concisely and cite the exact documentation page.", "rows": 3, "name": "instructions"} ]

Component Parameter Description text_input label, value, placeholder, name, auto_submit Single-line input field; binds to name inside form() or filter_bar(). textarea_input label, value, placeholder, rows, name, auto_submit Multi-line input with configurable visible rows.
